title: Dr. Dana Johnson - Videos
description:
I help parents of autistic children understand what’s really driving their child’s challenges- especially when progress doesn’t make sense. If you’ve tried the therapies, followed the recommendations, and still feel stuck- you’re in the right place.

I’m Dr. Dana Johnson, PhD, MS, OTR/L — an occupational therapist and researcher with advanced training in whole-body apraxia, neuromotor development, and functional medicine.

On this channel, you’ll learn:
Why behavior-focused autism therapy often misses the root cause
How whole-body apraxia affects speech, movement, regulation, and learning
What motor planning, sensory regulation, and brain-body connection really mean for autistic children
Why progress can feel stuck even with therapy.

Subscribe if you want clarity instead of confusion - and a new way to understand your child.

DISCLAIMER: The content on this channel should not be taken as medical advice or as a client-therapist relationship. Please consult your doctor.
